raw_html: [[Sun Burst#Shield of Greater Sunburst|Shield of Greater Sunburst]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Sun Burst#Shield of Greater Sunburst|Shield of Greater Sunburst]]:''' This item blazes with the eternal fury at the heart of a sun. Occasionally, this power comes to the surface, unleashing a nova of light which will [[blind]] the struck enemy, dealing severe light damage to it and any other nearby foes.
